record.title: Latvia prohibits nonessential European-origin entry through passenger carriers and for non-exempt private travellers in February 2021
record.scope: European-origin admission prohibition, including cross-border bus/rail passengers; important private-vehicle nationality/residence exception
record.crossings: Latvian land-entry routes, including Estonia and Lithuania
record.movement: Nonessential passengers using international carriers and private-vehicle users outside the express nationality/residence exemption.
record.exceptions: Essential purposes and commercial transport staff; from onset, non-commercial-vehicle entry by EU (including Latvian), EEA, Swiss and UK nationals, and EU permanent residents holding a Latvian residence permit, was not restricted under this provision.
record.imposing_authority: Latvian Cabinet and State Border Guard
record.enforcement: Border Guard guidance expressly covers carrier and private-vehicle arrivals.
record.consequences: Restricted nonessential European-origin entry; no quantified losses adopted.
record.relationship: Promotes February phase from R4-EU-L002; distinct from R4-EU-003’s March 2020 Russia/Belarus external-border regime.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; not a present-day status assessment
record.context: The February measure covered EU/EEA, Swiss and UK origins, with an express private-vehicle exception from onset. June 16 formally permitted nonessential European-origin travel also for unvaccinated people, subject to health conditions.
record.uncertainty: June 16 is formal European-origin permission, not an observed first crossing. Unvaccinated entrants remained subject to testing/isolation; very-high-risk origin exceptions and intermediate amendments require separate treatment.

historical.duration_note: Formal permission or repeal; operational continuity and first physical reopening are not established. Private-vehicle exceptions existed from onset; changing carrier/category rules and formal permission do not establish one operational interval.
